name: token-receiver
description: Callback endpoint for beacons (DNS names, web bugs, kubeconfig files) created on the Hub's Beacons page: an authoritative-only DNS server for one delegated zone and a fixed 1x1-GIF HTTP endpoint. A used beacon raises beacon_triggered.
author: TrueSignal
documentation: Deploy on its own internet-facing node; the Hub stays internal and the node only needs outbound HTTPS to it. Delegate a subdomain (for example t.example.com) to this host with an NS record and glue, and expose udp+tcp on TS_DNS_PORT and tcp on TS_HTTP_PORT. DNS answers SOA/NS at the apex and A (TS_ANSWER_IPV4) for names in the zone, NODATA otherwise, and REFUSED outside the zone: no recursion, no forwarding. Tokens carry an HMAC tag under the Hub-derived TS_BEACON_KEY, so invented names raise nothing. Replies are rate-limited per source (50/s) and small, so spoofed queries cannot use it as an amplifier. X-Forwarded-For is believed only from TS_TRUSTED_PROXIES. Runs as UID 0 with every capability dropped except NET_BIND_SERVICE (ports 53 and 80 in host networking). Read-only filesystem, no-new-privileges.

config.name: TS_BEACON_DOMAIN
config.description: Delegated zone the receiver is authoritative for (for example t.example.com). New beacons on the Hub point into it.

config.name: TS_BEACON_NS
config.description: Comma-separated NS names for the zone (default ns1.<zone>)

config.name: TS_ANSWER_IPV4
config.description: IPv4 address A queries in the zone resolve to (this node's public address), so web bugs reach the HTTP endpoint

config.name: TS_TRUSTED_PROXIES
config.description: Comma-separated IPs or CIDRs of a TLS front end whose X-Forwarded-For is believed

config.name: TS_ALERT_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: One event per token and channel per this many seconds; repeats are counted

config.name: TS_BEACON_KEY
config.description: Beacon tag key derived by the Hub

triggers.name: beacon_triggered
triggers.description: A beacon token was resolved or fetched; the Hub resolves it to the beacon it created (unknown tokens are medium)

triggers.name: receiver_saturated
triggers.description: Connections were refused at the per-source or total cap (at most once per 5 minutes per listener)
